template: Open {{v2}} in the browser. If a login page appears, log in with username '{{v3}}' and password '{{v4}}' (type that password text exactly as given into the password field). Then open the Contacts app and create a new contact named '{{v5}}' with its City field set to '{{v6}}'. Save the contact and report the exact Name and City values shown on the saved contact page.
